required_actions: Press and release Shift, Command, and 4 together (critical)
Pointer turns into a crosshair (what user sees)
Click and hold the mouse or trackpad button (critical)
Release the button to take the screenshot (critical)
Optional: Esc cancels; thumbnail may appear in the corner; file saves to desktop
Select the Microsoft Store icon on the taskbar (critical)
Select More info next to the account picture (critical)
Find the app; a Download icon means it is not installed on this device
If not found in My Library, check Order history
